name: Display Name
description: Provides a configurable 'display_name' field type (title/first/middle/last/full/nickname components) with a component widget, a token-pattern formatter, autocomplete, a Views fulltext filter, a Feeds target, and an optional override of the core username.
project_description: Display Name defines a multi-component 'display_name' field type for storing a person's name as separate parts (title, first, middle, last, full, alias/nickname). A component widget captures each part, and a format-string parser renders the stored parts into a chosen pattern with optional per-component markup (plain, component-class spans, RDFa, or microdata). It ships an autocomplete controller, a Views fulltext filter that searches across all name columns, and a Feeds import target. When a display_name field is added to the user entity the module can override Drupal's rendered username with the formatted display name via hook_user_format_name_alter().
